title: tdotnet
description: T Dot Net is a local broadband internet service provider (ISP) operating in Bangladesh, primarily serving areas in Jhikargacha, Jessore (such as Fatepur and Narangali Bazaar). Service Details Core Services: High-speed home and corporate broadband internet, Wi-Fi setups, and network troubleshooting Popular Packages: Offers budget-friendly tiers like 30 Mbps for ৳500/month and 70 Mbps for ৳525/month, alongside higher speeds up to 100 Mbps. Features: Includes unlimited access to Facebook and YouTube, FTP server access, and a dedicated client mobile app (developed by SoftifyBD) for managing accounts and paying bills via bKash (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.softifybd.tdotnet)
